situations.title: 대기실 안내
situations.tagline: Where should we wait while my husband's in surgery?
situations.brief: 가족에게 대기실 위치와 이용 방법을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: You can wait right here in the surgical waiting area.
There's coffee and restrooms just down the hall.
We'll come find you here with any updates.

situations.title: 예상 소요 시간 안내
situations.tagline: How long do you think the operation will take?
situations.brief: 예상 수술 소요 시간을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: The surgery usually takes about two to three hours.
That includes prep and recovery afterward.
Times can vary, and we'll keep you posted.

situations.title: 진행 상황 업데이트
situations.tagline: It's been a while — is there any news on how she's doing?
situations.brief: 수술 중간 진행 상황을 가족에게 업데이트하세요.
keyPhrases: The team just let me know things are going well.
She's stable and the surgery is progressing.
I'll come back with the next update.

situations.title: 가족 질문 응대
situations.tagline: Will he be in a lot of pain when he wakes up?
situations.brief: 가족의 질문에 명확하고 안심되게 응대하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll manage his pain closely in recovery.
He'll have medication ready the moment he needs it.
That's a common concern, and we plan for it.

situations.title: 회복실 면회 안내
situations.tagline: When can I go back and see her after the surgery?
situations.brief: 회복실 면회 시점과 절차를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: You can see her once she's settled in recovery.
A nurse will come get you when she's ready.
Usually that's about thirty minutes after surgery.

situations.title: 연락 방법 안내
situations.tagline: What if I step out — how will you reach me?
situations.brief: 가족과의 연락 방법을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Leave me your cell number and I'll call you.
There's a pager system if you prefer.
Please stay reachable in case we have news.
goals: 자리를 비울 때의 연락 체계를 안내한다

situations.title: 수술 지연 사유 설명
situations.tagline: You said it would start an hour ago — why hasn't it begun yet?
situations.brief: 수술 지연 사유를 가족에게 이해하기 쉽게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The earlier case ran longer than expected.
The delay is to make sure everything's ready and safe.
I'll update you the moment we have a start time.
goals: 지연이 안전을 위한 것임을 안심되게 전한다

situations.title: 장시간 수술 안심
situations.tagline: It's taking so much longer than you said — is something wrong?
situations.brief: 장시간 수술에 불안한 가족을 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: A longer surgery doesn't always mean a problem.
The team is being thorough and careful.
I checked in, and things are progressing steadily.

situations.title: 불안 가족 정서 지지
situations.tagline: I just can't stop worrying — I don't know what to do with myself.
situations.brief: 불안이 심한 가족에게 정서적 지지를 제공하세요.
keyPhrases: It's completely understandable to feel this way.
Would it help to sit down and talk for a moment?
You're not alone — I'm here with you.

situations.title: 제한된 정보 범위 소통
situations.tagline: Can't you just tell me exactly what they're doing to him in there?
situations.brief: 전달 가능한 정보 범위 내에서 성실히 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: I can share that he's stable and doing well.
The surgeon will explain the details afterward.
I want to give you accurate information, not guesses.
goals: 전달 가능한 정보 범위 내에서 소통한다

situations.title: 다국어 가족 소통
situations.tagline: My English isn't good — please, is my son okay?
situations.brief: 언어 장벽이 있는 가족과 통역을 활용해 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Your son is doing well — he's stable.
Let me get an interpreter so we understand each other.
I'll speak slowly and make sure you follow.
goals: 언어 장벽이 있는 가족과 명확히 소통한다

situations.title: 소아 보호자 소통
situations.tagline: She's only seven — I can't stand being away from her right now.
situations.brief: 소아 환자의 보호자를 안심시키며 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Your daughter is in very good hands.
The pediatric team specializes in caring for children.
I'll bring you to her as soon as she's in recovery.

situations.title: 면회 규정 설명
situations.tagline: Why can only one of us go back to see her at a time?
situations.brief: 회복실 면회 규정을 이해하기 쉽게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We keep recovery calm, so one visitor at a time.
It helps us monitor her closely and safely.
You can switch out so everyone gets to see her.

situations.title: 추가 시술 결정 소통
situations.tagline: The surgeon says they found something and need to do more — what does that mean?
situations.brief: 추가 시술 결정에 관한 소통을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: They found something that needs to be addressed now.
The surgeon will explain the details and options.
I'll make sure your questions get answered.
goals: 추가 시술 결정 상황을 가족에게 전달한다

situations.title: 종교적 요구 조율
situations.tagline: Before surgery, our faith asks that we say a prayer together — is that possible?
situations.brief: 가족의 종교적 요구를 존중하며 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll do our best to honor your request.
I can arrange a moment before we take him back.
Our chaplain is also available if you'd like.

situations.title: 술중 합병증 소식 전달
situations.tagline: The nurse said the surgeon wants to talk to us — did something go wrong?
situations.brief: 술중 합병증 소식을 가족에게 신중히 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: There was a complication during the surgery.
The team is managing it and she's stable right now.
The surgeon will explain everything in detail.

situations.title: 나쁜 소식 준비·전달
situations.tagline: Please, just tell me straight — is he going to be okay?
situations.brief: 나쁜 소식 전달을 준비하고 가족을 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's sit down together — I have some difficult news.
I want to be honest with you about what happened.
Take whatever time you need, and I'm right here.

situations.title: 사망 소식 지원
situations.tagline: No — you're telling me he's gone? He can't be gone.
situations.brief: 사망 소식을 접한 가족을 정서적으로 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm so deeply sorry for your loss.
Take all the time you need — I'm here with you.
When you're ready, I can help with the next steps.
goals: 사망 소식을 접한 가족을 정서적으로 지원한다

situations.title: 분노·항의 가족 대응
situations.tagline: This is your fault — you people did something wrong in there, didn't you?
situations.brief: 분노하고 항의하는 가족에게 침착히 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I can see how upset and angry you are.
Your feelings are completely valid right now.
Let's sit down and I'll answer everything I can.

situations.title: 응급 상황 급한 소통
situations.tagline: Why is everyone suddenly rushing — what's happening to my wife?
situations.brief: 응급 상황에서 가족과 급히 그러나 명확히 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Her condition changed and the team is acting fast.
They're doing everything they can right now.
I'll come back the moment I have more to tell you.

situations.title: 위기 중 가족 결정 지원
situations.tagline: They need me to decide something right now, and I don't know what's right.
situations.brief: 위기 상황에서 가족의 결정을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me explain the options as clearly as I can.
Think about what he would have wanted.
Whatever you decide, we'll support you fully.
